title: Custom Glowing Soccer Ball Trails Comforter Set, Machine Washable - A6
description:
Ignite the passion for soccer with this custom Soccer Player Comforter Set from Jeminise, designed for young enthusiasts. This vibrant bedding set celebrates the spirit of the game, inspiring dreams of athletic greatness while adding a dynamic touch to any boys' room.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Features a dynamic soccer theme, perfect for inspiring young fans and decorating a boys' room.
  • Personalized Design: Customize this comforter set with a name and number for a unique touch.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy to Use: Designed with a hidden zipper and a smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Utilizes environmental protection techniques to ensure dye retention and prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting durability.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; microfiber dries quickly without heat, maintaining its fluffiness.
  • Included Components: This set includes one duvet cover.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Sets
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Design Soccer Player
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization Text input (name & number)
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Sham Quantity 2
Thread Count 360
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Style Modern
